claim_boundary: Training-only development selection evidence; not a confirmation result and not language-model capability evidence.
exploratory_context: The rule and budget were informed by a previously recorded exploratory training-only sweep. Confirmation held-out outcomes were not used to choose them. This replay is development evidence and does not update the already frozen confirmation protocol.
purpose: Select and independently replay a conservative update budget using development training data only; no held-out data are generated.
selection_rule: Choose the largest candidate update count for which mean training-context KL to the uniform reference is <=0.45 and every development seed has training-context KL <=0.50. Compute metrics only on the examples used to update that seed policy. No held-out contexts or labels are generated in development.

training_data.generator: Same deterministic synthetic teacher and pairwise sampler as the frozen confirmation protocol; development seeds are disjoint from confirmation seeds.
